[Feat] [NPU] minimax-h3: Add Ascend NPU support for MiniMax-H3 hybrid window attention

## Motivation

MiniMax-H3's VDN hybrid window attention backend (`HYBRID_WINDOW_ATTN_H3`) was CUDA-only:

- the per-segment dense kernel was hard-wired to CUDA FlashAttention;
- the backward path used `torch.cuda` side streams for the linear readout branch;
- `NPUPlatformBase` had no mapping for `AttentionBackendEnum.HYBRID_WINDOW_ATTN_H3`, so the backend silently fell back to Torch SDPA on Ascend.

This PR enables the backend to run natively on Ascend NPU while keeping the existing CUDA behavior unchanged.

## Modifications

**`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/attention/backends/hybrid_window_attn_h3.py`**
- Import `current_platform` alongside `AttentionBackendEnum`.
- In `_fa_varlen`, when `q.device.type == "npu"`, dispatch to `ascend_fa.fused_infer_attention_varlen(q, k, v, cu_q, cu_k, softmax_scale=scale)` instead of `flash_attn_varlen_func`, preserving the same varlen decomposition and honoring the optional `out` buffer via `copy_`.
- In `HybridWindowAttentionH3Impl.__init__`, select `AscendFAImpl` as the dense fallback on NPU (`current_platform.is_npu()`), and keep `FlashAttentionImpl` on other platforms.

**`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/models/dits/minimax_h3_vdn_attention.py`**
- In `_vdn_ulysses_hybrid_core`, add an NPU path that runs the softmax branch and the linear readout branch on the current stream (no CUDA side-stream contract on Ascend), while still issuing both backward a2a trips and overlapping them via `softmax_work.wait()` / `linear_work.wait()`.
- CUDA/ROCm path is unchanged: still uses `_linear_branch_stream` with `wait_stream` synchronization around the side stream.

**`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/platforms/npu.py`**
- Register `AttentionBackendEnum.HYBRID_WINDOW_ATTN_H3` in `NPUPlatformBase` and return `sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.hybrid_window_attn_h3.HybridWindowAttentionH3Backend`, with an info log.

## Accuracy Tests

CUDA path is a behavioral no-op (branch only taken when `q.device.type == "npu"` / `current_platform.is_npu()`), so no accuracy change is expected on NVIDIA hardware.

 )
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.minimax_h3_vdn import VDNH3Layout
-from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import (
+    AttentionBackendEnum,
+    current_platform,
+)
 
 _DIT_BLOCK_PREFIX = re.compile(r"^blocks\.(\d+)\.")
 
@@ -306,6 +309,25 @@ def _fa_varlen(
     scale: float,
     out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if q.device.type == "npu":
+        # Ascend TND packed attention keeps the exact same decomposition math;
+        # only the dense per-segment kernel differs from CUDA FlashAttention.
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.ascend_fa import (
+            fused_infer_attention_varlen,
+        )
+
+        attn_out = fused_infer_attention_varlen(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            cu_q,
+            cu_k,
+            softmax_scale=scale,
+        )
+        if out is not None:
+            out.copy_(attn_out)
+            return out
+        return attn_out
     attn_out = flash_attn_varlen_func(
         q,
         k,
@@ -344,14 +366,28 @@ def __init__(
         match = _DIT_BLOCK_PREFIX.match(prefix)
         self.layer_idx = int(match.group(1)) if match else None
         # non-DiT callers (the token refiner) resolve this backend too: dense FA
-        self._dense_fallback = _flash_attn_backend.FlashAttentionImpl(
-            num_heads=num_heads,
-            head_size=head_size,
-            causal=causal,
-            softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
-            num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
-            prefix=prefix,
-        )
+        if current_platform.is_npu():
+            from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.ascend_fa import (
+                AscendFAImpl,
+            )
+
+            self._dense_fallback = AscendFAImpl(
+                num_heads=num_heads,
+                head_size=head_size,
+                causal=causal,
+                softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+                num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+                prefix=prefix,
+            )
+        else:
+            self._dense_fallback = _flash_attn_backend.FlashAttentionImpl(
+                num_heads=num_heads,
+                head_size=head_size,
+                causal=causal,
+                softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+                num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
+                prefix=prefix,
+            )
 
     def forward(
         self,

@@ -523,14 +523,21 @@ def linear_branch() -> torch.Tensor:
     # the linear readout and its a2a run on the side stream while FA4 (issued
     # first) holds the current one; both read the exchanged q/k/v, frame sums and
     # gate, so the side stream waits for them and the current stream joins before the merge
-    main_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device)
-    side_stream = _linear_branch_stream(q.device)
-    side_stream.wait_stream(main_stream)
-    softmax_out = softmax()
-    softmax_work, softmax_recv = a2a_back(softmax_out, role="vdn_out0")
-    with torch.cuda.stream(side_stream):
+    if q.device.type == "npu":
+        # Ascend has no CUDA side-stream contract here; run both branches on the
+        # current stream and keep the two backward a2a trips overlapped.
+        softmax_out = softmax()
+        softmax_work, softmax_recv = a2a_back(softmax_out, role="vdn_out0")
         linear_work, linear_recv = a2a_back(linear_branch(), role="vdn_out1")
-    main_stream.wait_stream(side_stream)
+    else:
+        main_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device)
+        side_stream = _linear_branch_stream(q.device)
+        side_stream.wait_stream(main_stream)
+        softmax_out = softmax()
+        softmax_work, softmax_recv = a2a_back(softmax_out, role="vdn_out0")
+        with torch.cuda.stream(side_stream):
+            linear_work, linear_recv = a2a_back(linear_branch(), role="vdn_out1")
+        main_stream.wait_stream(side_stream)
     softmax_work.wait()
     linear_work.wait()
     merged_softmax = _vdn_merge_heads(softmax_recv)

@@ -168,6 +168,15 @@ def get_attn_backend_cls_str(
                     "Manual installation from source is required. See https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-kernel-npu."
                 ) from e
 
+        elif selected_backend == AttentionBackendEnum.HYBRID_WINDOW_ATTN_H3:
+            from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.hybrid_window_attn_h3 import (  # noqa: F401
+                HybridWindowAttentionH3Backend,
+            )
+
+            logger.info("Using Ascend Hybrid Window Attention H3 backend.")
+
+            return "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.hybrid_window_attn_h3.HybridWindowAttentionH3Backend"
+
         logger.info("Using Torch SDPA backend.")
         return (
